translation: Well, I don't really care about Kyon.

That begs the question of why you didn't just
leave me alone from the start, then.

Damn it. I wasn't even able to justify this
shameful sight to Asahina.
More importantly! Attention, everyone!
I've figured out the truth behind this case!
The… truth? What's this all of a sudden?

I'm talking about the man-eating classroom
of course!

I've finally arrived at the astounding truth!
I—the great detective—have done it!
Go on, tell us what it is, I guess.
When you hear it, you'll be shocked for sure.

It's a perfect and unobjectionable
conclusion.

That's rather intriguing. What in the world
could said truth be?

I had two clues, from which I was able to draw
a single conclusion.
Those clues being… these!

Bursting with confidence, Haruhi pointed at
the poster the computer society created…
…as well as the plate with "1-6” written on it.

It seems like our efforts have paid off… for
now at least.
How are those two things connected?

I'll just pretend I don't have a clue and see
what Haruhi's reasoning is.
As usual, you don't even try to think about it.
What I do is none of your business.

Don't worry Kyon, I'll make sure I explain it in a
way that even you'll understand.

I'm truly grateful. Now just use that kindness
to call off this whole summer camp.
Firstly, take a look at this plate.
The plate for class 1-6, right?

Right. This is the plate that hangs over class
1-6.

The question is—why has this plate been
taken down?
Mikuru, you get it?
Huh?
Ah, no… Um… I don't understand.
Well, that's what I expected.

To put it simply, the culprit offset each plate
one across.
Look.

First, they took off class 6's plate and
brought over the neighboring class 7 plate.

If you continue to offset them with class 8
and class 9 and so on…
Before you know it, you've got a class 1-10.

However, this would mean only class 1-10
wouldn't have a plate…

Oh right, so only that classroom is left
without a plate.
I knew you would come around.
She's enjoying herself an awful lot, Haruhi.
That's where these posters come in.

Haruhi took out one of the computer society's
water conservation posters.
Look at this bit of the poster.
The "H2O” part.
It looks just like it says "1-10,” right?
Certainly I wouldn't say you're wrong, but…

The culprit tampered with the poster to make
it easy to mistake.

Now I see. What magnificent deductions, Miss
Suzumiya.

Koizumi you sly dog. He really appears
genuinely impressed by her.
What do you think? Perfect deduction isn't it?

Indeed. What else should I expect of Miss
Suzumiya. I'm very impressed.
A-amazing, Suzumiya.

I can't believe it. Haruhi really doesn't seem to
suspect that any of this was set up.
This was definitely set up as a prank.

I wonder if maybe someone in the computer
society was messing with the other members?
How come?

I might be pushing it, but I'll ask so Haruhi can
reinforce her conclusion.

Right… It sounds like they've been doing all
nighters—could it have been to vent stress?

Though unfortunately it means our
interrogations were in vain.

A water saving poster and a class plate? I
never would've figured it out.

I continued to feign my ignorance by saying
such things.

That's why you're only a low-ranking brigade
member. You need to think outside of the box!
Say whatever you want.

As long as Haruhi is satisfied with the
explanation, I have nothing to complain about.
About Haruhi
